014package org.microbean.scopelet;
015
016import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles;
017import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles.Lookup;
018import java.lang.invoke.VarHandle;
019
020import java.util.List;
021import java.util.Map;
022
023import org.microbean.attributes.Attributes;
024import org.microbean.attributes.BooleanValue;
025import org.microbean.attributes.Value;
026
027import org.microbean.bean.Bean;
028import org.microbean.bean.Factory;
029import org.microbean.bean.Request;
030
031import static org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers.primordialQualifier;
032import static org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers.qualifier;
033
034/**
035 * A manager of object lifespans on behalf of one or more notional <dfn>scopes</dfn>.
036 *
037 * @param <S> the {@link Scopelet} subtype extending this class
038 *
039 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
040 */
041public abstract class Scopelet<S extends Scopelet<S>> implements AutoCloseable, Factory<S> {
042
043
044  /*
045   * Static fields.
046   */
047
048
049  private static final VarHandle CLOSED;
050
051  private static final VarHandle ME;
052
053  static {
054    final Lookup lookup = MethodHandles.lookup();
055    try {
056      CLOSED = lookup.findVarHandle(Scopelet.class, "closed", boolean.class);
057      ME = lookup.findVarHandle(Scopelet.class, "me", Scopelet.class);
058    } catch (final NoSuchFieldException | IllegalAccessException e) {
059      throw new ExceptionInInitializerError(e);
060    }
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the <dfn>scope designator</dfn>.
065   */
066  public static final Attributes SCOPE = Attributes.of("Scope");
067
068  private static final Map<String, Value<?>> normalScope = Map.of("normal", BooleanValue.of(true));
069
070  private static final Map<String, Value<?>> pseudoScope = Map.of("normal", BooleanValue.of(false));
071
072  /**
073   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the (well-known) <dfn>singleton pseudo-scope</dfn>.
074   *
075   * <p>The {@link Attributes} constituting the singleton pseudo-scope identifier is {@linkplain Attributes#attributes()
076   * attributed} with {@linkplain #SCOPE the scope designator}, {@linkplain org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers#qualifier()
077   * the qualifier designator}, and {@linkplain org.microbean.assign.Qualifiers#primordialQualifier() the primordial
078   * qualifier}, indicating that the scope it identifies governs itself.</p>
079   */
080  public static final Attributes SINGLETON_ID =
081    Attributes.of("Singleton", pseudoScope, Map.of(), Map.of("Singleton", List.of(qualifier(), SCOPE, primordialQualifier())));
082
083  /**
084   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the (well-known and <dfn>normal</dfn>) <dfn>application scope</dfn>.
085   */
086  public static final Attributes APPLICATION_ID =
087    Attributes.of("Application", normalScope, Map.of(), Map.of("Application", List.of(qualifier(), SCOPE, SINGLETON_ID)));
088
089  /**
090   * An {@link Attributes} identifying the (well-known) <dfn>none pseudo-scope</dfn>.
091   */
092  public static final Attributes NONE_ID =
093    Attributes.of("None", pseudoScope, Map.of(), Map.of("None", List.of(qualifier(), SCOPE, SINGLETON_ID)));
094
095
096  /*
097   * Instance fields.
098   */
099
100
101  private volatile S me;
102
103  private volatile boolean closed;
104
105
106  /*
107   * Constructors.
108   */
109
110
111  /**
112   * Creates a new {@link Scopelet}.
113   */
114  protected Scopelet() {
115    super();
116  }
117
118
119  /*
120   * Instance methods.
121   */
122
123
124  /**
125   * Creates this {@link Scopelet} by simply returning it.
126   *
127   * @return this {@link Scopelet}
128   */
129  @Override // Factory<S>
130  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
131  public final S create(final Request<S> r) {
132    if (ME.compareAndSet(this, null, this)) { // volatile write
133      if (r != null) {
134        // TODO: emit initialized event
135      }
136    }
137    return (S)this;
138  }
139
140  /**
141   * Returns this {@link Scopelet} if it has been created via the {@link #create(Request)} method, or {@code null} if
142   * that method has not yet been invoked.
143   *
144   * @return this {@link Scopelet} if it has been "{@linkplain #create(Request) created}"; {@code null} otherwise
145   *
146   * @see #create(Request)
147   */
148  @Override // Factory<S>
149  public final S singleton() {
150    return this.me; // volatile read
151  }
152
153  /**
154   * Returns {@code true} when invoked to indicate that {@link Scopelet} implementations {@linkplain
155   * Factory#destroy(Object, Request) destroy} what they {@linkplain #create(Request) create}.
156   *
157   * @return {@code true} when invoked
158   *
159   * @see Factory#destroy(Object, Request)
160   *
161   * @see #create(Request)
162   */
163  @Override // Factory<S>
164  public final boolean destroys() {
165    return true;
166  }
167
168
169  /*
170   * Repository-like concerns.
171   */
172
173
174  /**
175   * Returns {@code true} if and only if this {@link Scopelet} is <dfn>active</dfn> at the moment of the call.
176   *
177   * <p>Overrides of this method must ensure that if {@link #closed()} returns {@code true}, this method must return
178   * {@code false}.</p>
179   *
180   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link Scopelet} is <dfn>active</dfn> at the moment of the call
181   *
182   * @see #closed()
183   */
184  public boolean active() {
185    return !this.closed(); // volatile read
186  }
187
188  /**
189   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then returns {@code true} if and only
190   * if, at the moment of an invocation, this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and already contains an
191   * object identified by the supplied {@link Object}.
192   *
193   * <p>The default implementation of this method checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is
194   * active}, and then {@code true} if and only if the result of invoking the {@link #instance(Object, Factory,
195   * Request)} method with the supplied {@code id}, {@code null}, and {@code null} is not {@code null}.</p>
196   *
197   * <p>Subclasses are encouraged to override this method to be more efficient or to use a different algorithm.</p>
198   *
199   * @param id the {@link Object} serving as an identifier; may be {@code null} in certain pathological cases
200   *
201   * @return {@code true} if and only if, at the moment of an invocation, this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is
202   * active} and contains a preexisting object identified by the supplied {@link Object}
203   *
204   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
205   *
206   * @see #active()
207   *
208   * @see #instance(Object, Factory, Request)
209   */
210  // @Deprecated // This method is not actually used but would need to exist for design flaws in CDI
211  public boolean containsId(final Object id) {
212    return (id instanceof Request<?> r ? this.instance(r) : this.instance(id, null, null)) != null;
213  }
214
215  /**
216   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active}, and then returns the preexisting
217   * contextual instance identified by the supplied {@link Object}, or {@code null} if no such instance exists.
218   *
219   * <p>This convenience method checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active}, and then, if
220   * the supplied {@link Object} is not a {@link Request}, calls the {@link #instance(Object, Factory, Request)} method
221   * with the supplied {@code id}, {@code null}, and {@code null}, and returns its result.</p>
222   *
223   * <p>If the supplied {@link Object} <em>is</em> a {@link Request}, this method calls the {@link #instance(Request)}
224   * method with the supplied (cast) {@code id} and returns its result.</p>
225   *
226   * @param <I> the type of contextual instance
227   *
228   * @param id an {@link Object} serving as an identifier; may be {@code null} in certain pathological cases
229   *
230   * @return the contextual instance identified by the supplied {@link Object}, or {@code null} if no such instance
231   * exists
232   *
233   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
234   *
235   * @see #instance(Object, Factory, Request)
236   *
237   * @see #instance(Request)
238   */
239  // id is nullable.
240  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
241  public final <I> I get(final Object id) {
242    return id instanceof Request<?> r ? this.instance((Request<I>)r) : this.instance(id, null, null);
243  }
244
245  /**
246   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then eturns a contextual instance
247   * identified by the {@linkplain Request#beanReduction() identifying information} present within the supplied {@link
248   * Request}, creating the instance and associating it with the {@linkplain Request#beanReduction() identifying
249   * information} present within the supplied {@link Request} if necessary.
250   *
251   * @param <I> the type of contextual instance
252   *
253   * @param request a {@link Request}; may be {@code null} in which case the return value of an invocation of {@link
254   * #instance(Object, Factory, Request)} with {@code null} supplied for all three arguments will be returned instead
255   *
256   * @return an appropriate contextual instance, or {@code null}
257   *
258   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
259   *
260   * @see Request#beanReduction()
261   *
262   * @see #instance(Object, Factory, Request)
263   */
264  public final <I> I instance(final Request<I> request) {
265    if (request == null || request.primordial()) {
266      return this.instance(null, null, request);
267    }
268    final Bean<I> bean = request.beanReduction().bean();
269    return this.instance(bean.id(), bean.factory(), request);
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then returns a pre-existing or
274   * created-on-demand contextual instance suitable for the combination of identifier, {@link Factory} and {@link
275   * Request}.
276   *
277   * @param <I> the type of contextual instance
278   *
279   * @param id an identifier that can identify a contextual instance; may be {@code null}
280   *
281   * @param factory a {@link Factory}; may be {@code null}
282   *
283   * @param request a {@link Request}, typically the one in effect that is causing this method to be invoked in the
284   * first place; may be {@code null}
285   *
286   * @return a contextual instance, possibly pre-existing, or possibly created just in time, or {@code null}
287   *
288   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
289   */
290  // All parameters are nullable, perhaps pathologically. This helps permit super early bootstrapping.
291  public abstract <I> I instance(final Object id, final Factory<I> factory, final Request<I> request);
292
293  /**
294   * Checks to see if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is active} and then removes any contextual instance
295   * stored under the supplied {@code id}, returning {@code true} if and only if removal actually took place.
296   *
297   * <p><strong>The default implementation of this method always returns {@code false}.</strong> Subclasses are
298   * encouraged to override it as appropriate.</p>
299   *
300   * @param id an identifier; may be {@code null}
301   *
302   * @return {@code true} if and only if removal actually occurred
303   *
304   * @exception InactiveScopeletException if this {@link Scopelet} {@linkplain #active() is not active}
305   */
306  // id is nullable.
307  public boolean remove(final Object id) {
308    if (!this.active()) {
309      throw new InactiveScopeletException();
310    }
311    return false;
312  }
313
314  /**
315   * Irrevocably closes this {@link Scopelet}, and, by doing so, notionally makes it irrevocably {@linkplain #closed()
316   * closed} and {@linkplain #active() inactive}.
317   *
318   * <p>Overrides of this method must call {@link Scopelet#close() super.close()} as part of their implementation or
319   * undefined behavior may result.</p>
320   *
321   * @see #closed()
322   *
323   * @see #active()
324   */
325  // Most scopelets will want to override this to do additional work. They must call super.close() to ensure #closed()
326  // returns an appropriate value.
327  @Override // AutoCloseable
328  public void close() {
329    CLOSED.compareAndSet(this, false, true); // volatile write
330  }
331
332  /**
333   * Returns {@code true} if and only if at the moment of invocation this {@link Scopelet} is (irrevocably) closed (and
334   * therefore also {@linkplain #active() not active}).
335   *
336   * @return {@code true} if and only if at the moment of invocation this {@link Scopelet} is (irrevocably) closed (and
337   * therefore also {@linkplain #active() not active})
338   *
339   * @see #active()
340   */
341  protected final boolean closed() {
342    return this.closed; // volatile read
343  }
344
345}
